acquisition_method: Peptides were analyzed by LC-MS on an Exploris 480 mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA), operated in positive data-dependent acquisition (DDA) mode.
alkylation_reagent: The co-immunoprecipitation AIRE samples were reduced with dithiothreitol followed by alkylation with iodoacetamide and proteins precipitated in 90% ethanol and proteins were digested with trypsin.
